The personnel double-check the connection of the hoist hook to the heavy equipment.
The heavy equipment is lifted slightly as the personnel monitor the movement.

The personnel continue their work on the intricate internal components of the equipment.
A yellow strap is adjusted as part of the lifting or securing process.

A person checks the seating of the equipment on the support structure.
Personnel make final adjustments to the position of the heavy component.

One technician pushes the box into place while the other guides it carefully.
They continue to maneuver the component, ensuring it fits properly.
Final adjustments are made as the component is securely positioned in the assembly.
The scene transitions to a front view of a large circular mechanical part labeled "077".
Personnel stand on either side of the circular component, ready for the next step.
They begin to guide the circular assembly upwards using a hoist.
Personnel keep their hands on the frame to stabilize it during the lifting process.
The assembly rises steadily as the hoist operates in the hangar.
Personnel look up, monitoring the progress of the lift carefully.
The circular component is lifted higher into the air by the hoist.
Personnel maintain their positions, ensuring the load remains balanced during the lift.
The lift continues as the component reaches a higher point in the facility.
Personnel watch as the machinery is positioned for the next stage of assembly.
The large component is held steady in its elevated position by the personnel.
The scene transitions to a close-up of a technician working under the elevated machinery.
The technician reaches up to inspect or adjust a connection point on the device.
They focus on a specific area with numerous wires and mechanical components.
A second technician is visible in the background, also working on the assembly.
The technician in the foreground continues to manipulate parts of the machinery.
They appear to be connecting or disconnecting a cable within the assembly.
The technician looks closely at the equipment, ensuring precision in their work.
Personnel discuss the next steps while continuing their work on the machinery.
A hand is seen adjusting a small lever or connector on the machine.
The technician continues to work meticulously on the underside of the device.
They reach further into the assembly to access a hard-to-reach component.
The technician pulls back slightly, checking the work they just completed.
The scene transitions to a technician operating a control lever on the side of the equipment.
The technician pulls a lever, causing a mechanical action within the assembly.
They repeat the action, testing the movement of a specific component.
The technician observes the result of the mechanical adjustment they just made.
The scene transitions to a view of a technician working on the rear of the machinery.
The technician uses a tool to tighten or loosen a bolt on the back of the assembly.
They continue working on the back, focusing on a specific mechanical joint.
The technician reaches inside the frame to adjust more components of the machine.
They continue their task, ensuring all parts are correctly installed and secured.
